finding.title: Global search's Exams & Papers domain throws 'all.filter is not a function' on every query, making all assessments unsearchable
finding.detail: Add any assessment in Exams & Papers (or use the seeded/sample exams) and search its title, subject, or paper in global search (`KOS.search.run`). Once the `search-more` bundle loads, `examsDomain` reads `KOS.store.state.exams.assessments` — which is a keyed object map `{ [id]: assessment }` (invariant 120), never an Array — and calls `all.filter(...)`. That throws `TypeError: all.filter is not a function` on every search keystroke; `KOS.search.run`'s `safe()` wrapper (`js/core/search.js:331`) catches and silences the exception, so global search returns 0 exam matches on every account and viewport.
finding.rootCause: js/core/searchmore.js:104-106 — `var all = (ex && ex.assessments) || []; var out = all.filter(...)` treats the `state.exams.assessments` object map as an array instead of calling `KOS.exams.all()` or `Object.values(...)`; `js/core/search.js:331` swallows the thrown TypeError.
finding.evidence: Node boot + KOS.lazy.all() + KOS.exams.add({title:'UniqueQuantumExam2027',...}): typeof state.exams.assessments === 'object' (Array.isArray false); KOS.search.run('UniqueQuantumExam2027', cb) returned [] on done=true; calling KOS.search.more.sync[2] directly threw 'TypeError: all.filter is not a function'.
finding.fix: In `js/core/searchmore.js:105`, read `var all = KOS.exams && KOS.exams.all ? KOS.exams.all() : Object.values((ex && ex.assessments) || {});` and add a smoke assertion that `KOS.search.run` finds an added assessment by title.

finding.title: redraw.js READS omits state keys read by five views (#/files misses folders, #/mind/daily misses exams, #/calendar misses sessions, #/code and #/japanese miss errorLog), and smoke139 N fails to cover them
finding.detail: Horizontal Sweep 1 against invariant 164 found five undeclared top-level state dependencies in `js/core/redraw.js`: (1) `READS.files` (:96) and `STUDY` (:54, for a topic's Files tab) omit `'folders'` (1C UR-14 `state.folders`, read by `js/modules/files.js:263` and `js/core/files.js:145`), so creating, renaming, or deleting a folder in another tab or via cloud sync leaves `KOS.changes.relevant('files', null, ['folders']) === false` (no chip, no redraw; and `files.js:217` only clears a deleted `p.folder` on full view remount, not inside `paintFolders()`); (2) `READS.mind` (:73) omits `'exams'`, though `#/mind/daily` (`js/modules/mind.js:689,742-753` -> `KOS.mind.daily()`) reads `state.exams` to switch into `'Exam Season: reviews only'`; (3) `READS.calendar` (:77) omits `'sessions'`, though `js/modules/calendar.js:595` (`KOS.exams.startState` -> `startBy` -> `weeklyHours`) reads `state.sessions` to compute derived exam start-by dates; (4) `READS.code` (:71) and `READS.japanese` (:72) omit `'errorLog'`, though `js/modules/code.js:792` and `js/modules/jarun.js:580` mount `KOS.errorLog.inlinePill` (reading `state.errorLog`). `smoke139 N` missed all five because `seedAccount` seeds 0 files/folders and no active exam `startBy`, `SURF.reads` only traps keys already present on `Object.keys(state)`, and `tools/lib/view-surfaces.js` omits `['mind', { page: 'daily' }]` and post-answer study states.
finding.rootCause: js/core/redraw.js:54,71-73,77,96 missing `'folders'`, `'exams'`, `'sessions'`, and `'errorLog'`; js/modules/files.js:261 `paintFolders()` not resetting deleted `p.folder`; tools/lib/view-surfaces.js:20,28,42 lacking seeded file/folder/exam coverage and `mind:daily`.
finding.evidence: Node repro: (1) on `#/files` with a file attached, mutating `state.folders` gave `KOS.changes.diff === ['folders']`, `KOS.changes.relevant('files', null, ['folders']) === false`, `pending === null`; (2) running `SURF.reads` with optional state keys, 1 file, and 1 exam seeded immediately flagged `MISS: calendar -> ['sessions']`, `MISS: files -> ['folders']`, `MISS: mind {"page":"daily"} -> ['exams']`.
finding.fix: Add `'folders'` to `READS.files` and `STUDY`, `'exams'` to `READS.mind`, `'sessions'` to `READS.calendar`, and `'errorLog'` to `READS.code` and `READS.japanese` in `js/core/redraw.js`; reset stale `p.folder` in `paintFolders()` (`js/modules/files.js:263`); pre-populate optional state keys + 1 file/folder/exam and add `['mind', { page: 'daily' }]` in `tools/lib/view-surfaces.js`.

finding.title: cloudmerge merges state.srs and state.code.cards field by field instead of atomically by latest review, discarding newer reviews and creating chimera FSRS/leech records
finding.detail: When two devices review the same curriculum/custom flashcard, scheduled `q:`/`e:` question (`state.srs[key]`), or Code card (`state.code.cards[id]`) before syncing — or one device un-leeches a card (`leech: null, leechBase: 8`) while the other reviewed it — `KOS.cloudmerge.merge` merges the FSRS record key-by-key instead of keeping the more recent review whole. On a three-way merge where Local rated Good on 2026-09-20 (`s: 25, due: '2026-10-15'`) and Remote rated Again on 2026-09-24 (`s: 1.5, due: '2026-09-25', lapses: 8, leech: true`), Local wins same-key conflicts (`preferRemote: false`), discarding Remote's newer review and keeping `s: 25, due: '2026-10-15'`, while grafting Remote's newly added `leech: true` (or `leechBase`) onto the same record — leaving a corrupted chimera schedule.
finding.rootCause: js/core/cloudmerge.js:141,496-521 — `FACET_PATH = /^(japanese\.facets|mind\.cards)\.[^.]+$/` protects only Japanese facets and Mind cards; `srs.<key>` (whose keys also contain dots, e.g. `compsci:4.5.2.1:0`) and `code.cards.<id>` fall through to plain-object per-field `mergeValue`.
finding.evidence: Node repro via KOS.cloudmerge.merge(base, local, remote): `merged.doc.srs['compsci:4.2.1.1:0']` produced `{ reps: 8, lapses: 8, s: 25, d: 6.5, ivl: 25, due: '2026-10-15', last: '2026-09-20', leech: true }` (Remote's newer Sep 24 review lost while its `leech: true` was grafted onto Local's Sep 20 schedule); `code.cards['u1-swap']` similarly mixed Local's `s: 6, due: '2026-09-26'` with Remote's `lapses: 1`.
finding.fix: Widen `FACET_PATH` in `js/core/cloudmerge.js:141` to `/^(japanese\.facets\.[^.]+|mind\.cards\.[^.]+|code\.cards\.[^.]+|srs\..+)$/` (every `srs[key]` record holds primitive fields only) and break `last` ties safely so `leech`/`leechBase` and FSRS stability/due always travel together; add a regression case in `smoke135`/`smoke146`.
finding.phase1: Phase 1 `leechBase` (`js/core/srs.js:268`) widened the chimera surface; base `srs`/`code.cards` omission predates Phase 1

finding.title: Phase 1 Universal Error Log (`state.errorLog`) is missing from global search, Assistant domain tools, document tallies, cloudmerge `SET_FIELDS`, and flashcard-push Undo
finding.detail: Omission hunt + Sweep 1.4 across Phase 1's Universal Error Log (`f479433b..fa4264d0`) found five cross-cutting contract omissions: (1) Global search (`js/core/search.js`, `js/core/searchmore.js`, invariant 71) adds only the static `'Error Log'` page row in `PAGES` (`7734300b`) and never searches `state.errorLog.items` (`title`, `wrongNote`, `ruleNote`, `topicTitle`); (2) Assistant tools (`js/core/aitools.js:2796`, invariant 71a: 'Assistant tools cover every domain') only adds `'errorlog'` to `navigate`'s enum, with zero read/log/resolve tools for `KOS.errorLog`; (3) `KOS.store.tally()` (`js/core/store.js:1146`) omits `errorLog.items` from Restore and first-link before/after counts; (4) `SET_FIELDS` (`js/core/cloudmerge.js:124`) omits `mistakeTypes`, so two devices tagging different mistake types on the same entry do not union them as a set; (5) `toFlashcard` (`js/modules/errorlog.js:437-442,753-759`) creates a custom card and sets `cardId` with a plain toast lacking Undo, contrary to `js/modules/errorlog.js:4` ('every write passes through KOS.errorLog with Undo').
finding.rootCause: js/core/searchmore.js:248 (no `errorLogDomain`), js/core/aitools.js:2796 (no `errorlog_*` tools), js/core/store.js:1146 (`TALLY`), js/core/cloudmerge.js:124 (`SET_FIELDS`), and js/modules/errorlog.js:441,757 (toast without Undo).
finding.fix: Add `errorLogDomain` in `js/core/searchmore.js`, `errorlog_list`/`errorlog_add`/`errorlog_resolve` tools in `js/core/aitools.js`, `['errorLog.items', 'logged mistakes']` in `js/core/store.js:1146`, `mistakeTypes: true` in `js/core/cloudmerge.js:124` `SET_FIELDS`, and an Undo callback on `toFlashcard`'s toast (`KOS.srs.removeCustom(r.cardId)` + `E().update(id, { cardId: null })`).
